title: Host machine construction
statement: Given Boolean-alphabet machines $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$, define a Boolean-alphabet finite Turing machine with $3+2k_V+2k_I+2k_P+1$ work tapes, where each $k$ is the corresponding machine's number of work tapes. Its state is a host phase together with a state for that phase; it is the phase-host machine formed from the host phase machines, starting in setup at the cleanup initialization state for $M_P$'s initial state and using the host phase redirects.
